mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS > 12-month moving average does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening supply-side conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO < 6-month moving average does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over 3 consecutive months signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If a sustained 3-month decrease in FEDFUNDS does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 6-month average signals strengthening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 6-month average does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) above their respective 6-month averages signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS > 6-month averages do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a late-cycle regime.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 < 12-month moving average does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances during a late-cycle regime.
